using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.TemplateEngine;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace SemanticKernel.Core.Tests
{
    public class VarBlockTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void VarBlock_LogError_WhenContentIsEmpty()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerFactory = new LoggerFactory();
            var logger = loggerFactory.CreateLogger<VarBlock>();
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<VarBlock>>();
            var varBlock = new VarBlock(string.Empty, new LoggerFactory());

            // Act
            varBlock.IsValid(out _);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(l => l.LogError(It.IsAny<string>()), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void VarBlock_LogError_WhenContentLengthIsLessThan2()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerFactory = new LoggerFactory();
            var logger = loggerFactory.CreateLogger<VarBlock>();
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<VarBlock>>();
            var varBlock = new VarBlock("a", new LoggerFactory());

            // Act
            varBlock.IsValid(out _);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(l => l.LogError(It.IsAny<string>()), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void VarBlock_LogError_WhenContentDoesNotStartWithVarPrefix()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerFactory = new LoggerFactory();
            var logger = loggerFactory.CreateLogger<VarBlock>();
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<VarBlock>>();
            var varBlock = new VarBlock("abc", new LoggerFactory());

            // Act
            varBlock.IsValid(out _);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(l => l.LogError(It.IsAny<string>()), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
